newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.

text.p: Millfeed prices edged higher at a few locations and were steady at most others, as dealers in nearly all locations reported tight supplies available for prompt shipment.
"These flour mills are taking a lot of downtime for fumigation and maintenance," said a Chattanooga dealer.
Minnesota dealers reported tight millfeed supplies as flooding closed a Grand Forks, N.D., flour mill, prompting nearby mills outside the flood area to pick up that business.
Several dealers said higher wheat prices since last week discouraged millfeed buyers from bidding for deferred supplies, fearing wheat prices may later tumble and pull millfeed prices down with them.
A feed industry golf outing in Kansas City had dealers leaving work early, which resulted in light dealings in the Kansas City and interior Kansas/Oklahoma markets.
